_comment: the reference-scenario workflow. Every value was produced by a real
`controlloop gate` run against this branch, never hand-written.

A pre-commit hook repository's rev moves from a full commit SHA to a tag, so the hook code can change upstream with no change here. At the default high threshold the gate passes and reports the unpinned repository at medium; a repository with severity_threshold medium blocks it. The hook repository is fictional.

authority_statements: This change gives pre-commit the power to install plugin `pre-commit hook repository github.com/widgetworks-example/storefront-hooks`, unpinned, whose source changed (`.pre-commit-config.yaml`, plugin `pre-commit hook repository github.com/widgetworks-example/storefront-hooks`). No approval is recorded.
